videos.title: People's Palaces: The Golden Age of Civic Architecture
videos.description: Jonathan Foyle visits neo-Gothic Victorian buildings in northern England, as Gothic moved from sacred to secular to become the north's civic style of choice.

videos.title: Scotland: Rome's Final Frontier
videos.description: Archaeologist Dr Fraser Hunter looks back on three centuries of contact and conflict with Scotland's Roman invaders, a story of a superpower pitted against tribesmen and warlords.

videos.title: Treasures of the Anglo Saxons
videos.description: Dr Nina Ramirez reveals the codes and messages hidden in Anglo-Saxon art by examining artefacts like the Sutton Hoo treasures, the Staffordshire hoard and the Franks Casket.

videos.title: Sunday in the Park with Stephen - Omnibus
videos.description: Documentary that follows Stephen Sondheim teaching the creative process behind musicals.

videos.title: Stephen Sondheim's Old Friends
videos.description: Cameron Mackintosh invites many of Stephen Sondheim's old friends to join him in London's West End for a thrilling, joyously staged production featuring an all-star cast.

videos.title: Sondheim at the BBC
videos.description: A selection of Sondheim's finest songs performed by some of the world's greatest stars at the BBC, including Shirley Bassey, Sammy Davis Jr, Michael Ball and Liza Minnelli.

videos.title: Earth's Natural Wonders
videos.description: How people have devised remarkable ways to face the extremes of nature.

videos.title: The Story of Scottish Art
videos.description: Lachlan Goudie traces the development of Scottish art. He explores how it has left a remarkable legacy over the last century through wrestling with questions of identity.

videos.title: Mastermind: 1977
videos.description: Magnus Magnusson presents the quiz programme. The specialist subjects include English poetry of WWI, the Glorious Revolution and the Allied armies in Italy in WWII.

videos.title: Mastermind: 1977 Final
videos.description: Magnus Magnusson presents the 1977 final. The specialist subjects are the life of Francis Drake, the Roman Revolution, Stuart kings and queens 1603-1714 and children's literature.

videos.title: Saving Venice
videos.description: How Venetians are turning to revolutionary engineering, restoration of the natural environment and knowledge from their past in order to save Venice.

videos.title: Baku: An Art Lovers' Guide
videos.description: In the final episode of the series, our intrepid cultural explorers Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke set off on their most adventurous trip yet - to Baku, capital of Azerbaijan.
